header.name: Sattari lead-vocal corpus (Auto Pitch / Auto Key benchmarking)
header.access_rule: Read items ONLY through validation/leadvocal/corpus.py items(). The holdout-sealed split is opened only for milestone validation: items("holdout-sealed", allow_holdout=True) with LEADVOCAL_MILESTONE="<reason>" set; every opening is appended to validation/leadvocal/holdout-access.log (committed). Nothing is tuned on it.
header.split_rule: Split by SINGER and SONG jointly (seed 20260927). Every singer and every song (canonical song_id, shared across sources: e.g. love-me-tender, twinkle-twinkle tune) gets exactly one label in {holdout-sealed, validation, dev}; an item is kept only when its singer label equals its song label, otherwise it is excluded-crossover. Consequently no singer and no song appears in two splits. Items that earlier benchmarks tuned on (al_vocals dev, vocadito_bench dev) may not enter the sealed holdout (excluded-prior-tuning). Labels are chosen by simulated annealing that maximises the kept fraction per source, targets singer shares and kept-minute shares of holdout 20% / validation 15% / dev 65% per source (4 restarts, seeds SEED..SEED+3), and balances sex (labelled or inferred) and register between splits. Secondary Apple Loops items (harmony / background parts) follow their singer and song labels; the CSD sopranos are dev-only.
header.label_policy: Fields that cannot be derived are null (unknown). sex is null unless labelled by the source; sex_inferred is a pitch-based inference used only for balancing and coverage reporting.
header.register_rule: median MIDI vs sex: M low < 50 (D3) <= mid <= 57 (A3) < high; F low < 60 (C4) <= mid <= 67 (G4) < high
header.key_rule: duration-weighted Temperley (1999) profile correlation over note annotations; margin = r(best) - r(runner-up); key_ambiguous when margin < 0.05. key_windows: 30 s windows / 10 s hop, a segment needs >= 3 consecutive confident windows (diagnostic). modulation_candidates: same-mode segments >= 50 s whose tonic is 1-2 st from the global key. N20EM: performances of one song are grouped by pitch-class histogram (r >= 0.85) into arrangement groups (same backing-track key) and key_truth is the fit of the POOLED notes of the group (key_fit_item keeps the single-performance fit); modulation_confirmed = candidates shared by >= half of a group. Apple Loops keys are labels, cross-checked by a Temperley fit of the reference f0 (label_agrees_with_f0_fit).
